latin: Sub primo ducalis trinitatis est esse substantiale, omnis anima nobilis generationi non subdita, primum mobile, ignis et suprema aeris pars, quae super terram crescunt, et pars orientalis.
translation: Under the first member of the leader-triad fall: substantial being, every noble soul not subject to generation, the primum mobile, fire and the highest part of air, the things that grow above the earth, and the eastern region.
